name: Raffles Sentosa Singapore
positioning: All-villa Raffles resort set in rainforest on a hillside beside the South China Sea on Sentosa, where every villa has a private pool and an all-day butler
best_for: Couples wanting a private pool villa with butler service
Families or friends travelling together who want interconnecting villas
Travellers who want spa time and nature outings close to Singapore

facts.text: The pool villas sit within tropical rainforest on a hillside beside the South China Sea on Sentosa island.
Villa interiors are inspired by contemporary Singaporean design with touches of tradition.
Interconnecting villas are available for families or groups of friends.
Villa guests have a butler available all day.
Private in-villa dining is offered with a bespoke menu and butler service.
Empire Grill is the resort's relaxed modern Italian signature restaurant, serving classic Tuscan fare.
Royal China serves Cantonese cuisine, with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the garden.
Raffles Sentosa Spa is housed in a heritage building.
The spa offers yoga, mindfulness, massage, fitness, hydrotherapy and science-based skincare.
The spa has indoor hot and cold plunge pools.
Naturalist-led birdwatching walks on Sentosa are run by The Untamed Paths along the Mount Imbiah Nature Trail.
A Wellbeing Butler leads scent-making sessions where guests design their own fragrance to take home.

highlights.text: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property to open on Sentosa, and the second Raffles address in Singapore.
Each villa has separate pavilions for day and night, plus a private outdoor pool and terrace.
The hotel offers a guided tour of Singapore in the resort's Rolls-Royce, with a private guide and lunch at a heritage restaurant.
The resort has its own version of the Singapore Sling, the Raffles Sentosa Sling, with mixologist-led tasting sessions.
Guests can take a private yacht tour of Sisters' Islands.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the Sentosa Island location is less convenient for spontaneous trips into Singapore's city centre.
WhataHotel notes the all-villa format puts the resort at the higher end of Singapore's luxury pricing.
